## Bonepowder Ghoul (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
NE Small undead  
**Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +22  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 17, flat-footed 11 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)  
**hp** 255 (17d8+119)  
**Fort** +11, **Ref** +12, **Will** +12  
**Defensive Abilities** amorphous, channel resistance +4; **Immune** undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +19 (1d6+5 plus 1d3 Str and paralysis)  
**Special Attacks** coalesce, gravedust (DC 24), whirlwind  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 17th; concentration +23)  

At will—chill touch (DC 17), deeper darkness, dispel magic, ray of enfeeblement (DC 17)  
3/day—blindness/deafness (DC 18), empowered enervation  
1/day—energy drain  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 20, Con—, **Int** 19, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 22  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +16; **CMD** 27  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Empower Spell-Like Ability (enervation), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Spring Attack, Stealthy, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Agile Maneuvers and Weapon Finesse are one feat, Weapon Finesse; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite), Toughness; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Bluff +16, Climb, +15, Diplomacy +13, Disguise +15, Escape Artist +18, Fly +19, Intimidate +19, Knowledge (arcana) +20, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +19, Knowledge (history) +15, Knowledge (religion) +20, Perception +22, Spellcraft +14, Stealth +30; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Escape Artist, +4 Stealth  
**Languages** Common, Darakhul, Draconic, Dwarven, Undercommon  
**SQ** dusty form, hide in plain sight  


**Special Abilities**


**Coalesce (Su)** A bonepowder ghoul can temporarily assume a humanoid form by draining 5 or more Strength from a victim or with a successful enervation attack. This form is Small and semi-transparent but roughly the shape of a normal ghoul. It never lasts for more than 10 minutes/5 ability points drained. In this form, the ghoul can speak normally and manipulate objects.  

**Disease (Su)** Darakhul Fever: Bite—injury; *save* Fortitude DC 24; *onset* 1 day; *effect* damage 1d6 Con and 1d3 Dex; *cure* 2 consecutive saves.
